def main():
    s = input().strip()
    count = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        c = s[i]
        start = i
        while i < n and s[i] == c:
            i += 1
        if ((i - start) & 1) == 0:
            count += 1
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
